capabilities.remainingGates: Bounded values/queues/clocks/pacing, continuous linear/windowed-sinc conversion and statistical speech VAD implemented. Spectral and speech fixtures are synthetic; no corpus accuracy, universal quality or realtime qualification. No AEC/noise/AGC. Complete native routing and platform qualification remain open.
Ordinary RFC6716 framing/TOC/ranges only; no entropy validation, multistream or self-delimiting framing.

Owned bounded range coding with up to257-symbol models and pinned official entropy comparisons. Independently adopted SILK/CELT stages compose with it; primitive agreement alone does not establish complete RFC8251 codec conformance.
Exact bounded RFC6716 signed pulse enumeration/entropy. Recursive shape coding composes multiple admitted codebooks; the primitive alone has no audio, allocation or loss policy.

Owned pulse/shell/sign entropy, gain/NLSF/pitch/LTP parameters, fixed-point NLSF conversion/interpolation/stability and no-loss compressed channel-to-PCM16 reconstruction. Exact official integer PCM/history/entropy comparisons across successive frames. No encoder analysis/quantization, stereo, PLC/FEC or complete hybrid codec.

Owned recursive mono/stereo/intensity shape coding, theta, TF/Haar, folding/noise, shared all-band allocation balance and anti-collapse. Independent bytes/entropy/masks/seed comparisons and tolerance-qualified spectral comparisons. Complete encoder quality, hybrid/mode transitions and loss recovery remain separate.

Owned mixed-radix low-overlap CELT MDCT/IMDCT at four frame sizes in mono/stereo. CELTSynthesis separately composes transient/long windows, denormalization, pitch postfilter and deemphasis. Float comparison is tolerance-qualified; no universal realtime/perceptual claim.

Owned segmented headers, coarse/fine/final energies, bit allocation/skips/stereo, denormalization, variable-duration transient overlap, pitch postfilters and deemphasis. Exact entropy/integer decisions; floating PCM tolerance-qualified against pinned scalar reference. No perceptual analysis, PLC/FEC, complete hybrid or full official conformance claim.

Ordinary CELT long-block PCM encoding and ordinary no-loss frame/packet decoding; mono SILK-only decoding to48kPCM16 at fixed internal8/12/16kHz rate. No full SILK/hybrid encoding, SILK stereo/rate changes, hybrid/mode transitions, redundant-frame mixing, PLC/FEC/DTX or official full decoded-PCM conformance. Basic CELT encoder has no perceptual VBR/transient/pitch analysis. Zero/one-byte CELT and empty SILK loss frames reject explicitly.
Published XChaCha vectors, public AES256-GCM, bounded actor counters/replay. External crypto review and live interoperability remain open.
Eight-byte AES128-GCM tag adapter with NIST vectors. No ratchet/replay/nonce ownership or production audit.
MLS1.0/ciphersuite2 binary structures, TreeKEM, key schedule, signatures, proposals/commits/Welcome, membership/authentication and recovery are unimplemented.
Opaque opcode framing does not implement MLS coordination, sender ratchets, frame transforms, identity verification or epoch/transition interoperability.
Pure Voicev8 reducers and local generation fence. No timers, sockets, session manager or production E2EE backend.
Bounded RTPv2/extensions/padding,74-byte discovery, Opus counters/silence and caller-paced reorder. No socket ownership or PLC.
Per-guild network ownership, deadlines/cancellation/retry, SSRC/user mapping, DAVE pipelines and playback/recording are unimplemented.

Apple engine capture/playback, explicit macOS input/output UID selection, iOS/tvOS/visionOS preferred-input selection, bounded metadata/queues and observed lifecycle cleanup implemented. watchOS preferred input and arbitrary non-macOS output selection explicitly unsupported. Deterministic backend/property tests and selected-module cross-SDK compilation only; no permission/device/route/hot-unplug runtime qualification. Windows/Android adapters remain unimplemented. Linux PCM remains injected. Selected macOS liveness is checked after observer installation and engine start; failed listener installation rolls back atomically. These narrow startup races without guaranteeing device presence after readback.
Opaque H264/H265/VP8/VP9/AV1 and layer metadata only; negotiated video requirements, real codecs, DAVE parsing, RTP fragmentation/feedback and camera/GoLive remain unimplemented.
Public provider protocol evidence and actual multi-call media/device/global controls remain required; no native runtime wrapper.
External crypto audit, Opus/MLS/DAVE conformance, per-platform tests, authorized Discord smoke, ten-minute lossless duplex and frame-budget/RSS evidence have not run.
